text: NovaGrid Robotics today announced it has closed a $42 million Series B financing round led by Meridian Ventures, with participation from Blue Harbor Capital and existing investor Sequence Partners. The round values the company at $180 million post-money. NovaGrid Robotics plans to use the funds to scale manufacturing of its warehouse automation hardware.

Solace Health has raised $12 million in a Series A round led by Northgate Capital, with participation from existing seed investor Founders Bridge. The company was valued at $55 million following the round.
